integrity: An explicit infinite proof and an executable finite diagnostic are included. Computational checks do not replace the proof.
scientific_limitations: Only ordinary integral square and cube factors of the one-sided Mephisto Waltz fixed point are classified; fractional, Abelian, antipalindromic, and other morphic-word questions are outside the claim. title: Complete square spectrum and conjugacy count for the Mephisto Waltz word
